sample_unit: evaluations (41 questions x 3 submissions x 2 models, rated by 4 surgeons and 3 nurses)

links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading grade level of LLM answers versus recommended patient reading level
links.effect: Average reading level was 11th grade for GPT-4 and 10th grade for Gemini, above the recommended 6th grade level for patient information.
links.quote: The average reading level for GPT-4 and Gemini responses were 11th and 10th grade, above the recommended 6th grade reading level for patient information.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, helpfulness, and readability of ChatGPT-4 and Gemini in answering common postoperative gynecologic surgery questions without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
